notes.title: Sprite forge 1.0.6
notes.content:
Updated the appearance of all floating windows; they can now be moved.
Added a new "Auto" mode for automatic sprite template generation.
Fixed the issue where the pencil flickered over another color.
Added selection and the ability to move the selected sprite area.
Fixed the issue where sprites were not generated after deleting a color. Now, there will always be at least one color in the palette.
Updated the program help link.
Fixed the pencil issue when rapidly sketching.
